records.name: Salve amulet (e)

unlock.requirement: Haunted Mine for the base salve amulet; Lair of Tarn Razorlor for Tarn's diary and the enchantment

records.displayDescription: This is one of Morytania's strongest cross-region combat support unlocks because it materially improves undead methods outside Morytania, including Lumbridge Catacombs skeletons, bound skeletons, armoured phantoms, and armoured zombies. · Keep Morytania as the normal self-sufficient acquisition region unless Equilibrium explicitly grants the amulet or quest rewards globally. · Effects: +20% damage against undead enemies, +20% hit chance against undead enemies, Stacks with the full Slayer helmet, Void Knight equipment, the Undead Slayer perk, and the Undead Slayer ability, The bonus is on-hit and does not increase damage-over-time abilities or conjures

records.name: Amulet of the forsaken to Berserker's Fury

unlock.requirement: 56 Archaeology to activate Berserker's Fury; Saradominist I collection progression for the Lock of hair; Amulet of the forsaken from Barrows

sources.title: Amulet of the forsaken to Berserker's Fury

records.displayDescription: Both the Barrows amulet and the Saradominist I/Everlight side of the relic chain are Morytania content, making this a real single-region combat relic unlock rather than a generic Archaeology passive. · Quest auto-completion can satisfy quest gates, but it should not silently remove the Barrows item dependency unless Equilibrium says the relic itself is granted. · Effects: Berserker's Fury deals up to 5.5% more damage as current life points fall below maximum, Consumes 250 monolith energy when active, Does not stack with Dharok's set effect · Unlocks: Amulet of the forsaken as a Barrows reward, Dharok's Memento by combining the amulet with the Lock of hair, Berserker's Fury relic power

records.name: Igneous cape progression

unlock.requirement: Karamja: Fire cape for the one-time Fight Kiln entry payment; Karamja: Fight Kiln completion for a TokHaar-Kal cape; Misthalin working Senntisten mapping: defeat TzKal-Zuk without checkpoints for an igneous stone

records.displayDescription: The Zuk encounter supplies the igneous stone, but the stone upgrades a TokHaar-Kal cape from Karamja's Fight Kiln. A planner that shows only Misthalin materially understates the cape chain. · Display this as Karamja + Misthalin under the current Senntisten working map. If Equilibrium later assigns Senntisten differently, update only that side of the chain. · Unlocks: Igneous Kal-Ket, Igneous Kal-Xil, Igneous Kal-Mej, Igneous Kal-Mor, Igneous Kal-Zuk after the hard-mode flawless requirement and all four style capes

records.name: Holy wrench

unlock.requirement: Rum Deal; Pieces of Hate for the Dungeoneering prayer-necklace interaction

records.displayDescription: Morytania supplies the normal gameplay acquisition. Resolve the quests through the Equilibrium quest overlay separately. · Effects: Increases Prayer restored by supported prayer-restoring potions while carried or worn, After Pieces of Hate, Dungeoneering prayer necklaces restore 10% more Prayer

records.name: TokKul-Zo

unlock.requirement: The Elder Kiln in the normal game

records.displayDescription: This is a Karamja support unlock for the wave portions of the Zuk encounter and for the earlier TzHaar progression. Do not describe it as a 10% damage bonus against Zuk himself. · Effects: 10% increased damage against TzHaar, TokHaar, TzekHaar and Igneous TzekHaar, The damage effect works on TzekHaar waves but not TzKal-Zuk himself, Teleports around TzHaar City including Fight Cave, Fight Kiln and Fight Cauldron

records.name: Corporeal Beast holy-elixir supply

unlock.requirement: Summer's End for the normal-game Corporeal Beast progression

records.displayDescription: The Corporeal Beast cavern entrance is in the Wilderness. The lair itself is not dangerous Wilderness territory, but Forinthry is the useful region dependency for entering the normal self-supply chain. Holy elixir can also come from the tormented wraith, so this row describes the primary practical regional source rather than claiming Corp is the only source. · Unlocks: Holy elixir drop source, Spirit shield and sigil progression, Necrite and phasmatite stone-spirit supply relevant to Blessed flask crafting

records.name: Blessed flask production chain

unlock.requirement: 118 Herblore, boostable; 96 Crafting; Blessed flask shell and glorious silvthril chain; Holy elixir; Holy water; Five light cores; Five holy overload potions (6); Five extreme prayer potions (4); 500 positive energy

records.displayDescription: This is a real region-planning chain because no trading makes the ingredient sources matter, but it would be wrong to display Desert + Tirannwn + Karamja + Forinthry as four unconditional required picks while alternate supply routes and the unresolved Arc exist. Keep the full pressure visible instead. · Re-evaluate individual ingredient gates when Equilibrium publishes external-area handling, quest auto-completion details, or League-specific supply passives. · Effects: Holds up to 80 doses of extreme prayer in one inventory slot, At level 99 Prayer, 80 doses can represent up to 45,200 Prayer points before other modifiers, Holy wrench increases the Prayer restored per extreme-prayer dose and works with the Blessed flask · Region pressure: Desert: the normal direct source for the 1,200 red sandstone used in the shell chain; alternate account sources can weaken this as a hard region gate., Tirannwn: crystal-flecked sandstone and 5,000 harmonic dust are naturally supplied through Prifddinas; some alternate sources mean this is recorded as pressure rather than an unconditional hard gate., Karamja: Holy water production is learned through Legends' Quest and uses the Kharazi Jungle water pool., Forinthry: Corporeal Beast is the practical normal self-supply source for the holy elixir and several required stone spirits; the tormented wraith is an alternate holy-elixir source., External unresolved: 250 alaea sea salt comes from the Arc/Wushanko chain, which is not currently assigned to an Equilibrium elective region.
